result.title: Towards Consistent Geospatial Representations: Aligning One Encoder to Many Foundation Models
result.summary: Geospatial foundation models (GFMs) differ widely in pretraining objective, modality and resolution, and none leads across benchmarks. We ask whether their representations are complementary, and whether a single encoder can inherit that complementarity. We introduce Pangaea-Latents, an extension of the Pangaea benchmark providing frozen embeddings of $5$ GFMs over its $11$ datasets, along with reproduced baselines, and find GFM embeddings to be neither redundant nor disjoint. We then propose GeoMixture, a preliminary framework to align a ViT to several GFMs per dataset through a multi-representation alignment (mREPA) objective. Our encoder ties the best GFM in average rank across nine Pangaea datasets, trading peak performance for cross-task consistency.

AI.brief_summary: 论文发布 Pangaea-Latents（11 个数据集上 5 个地理空间基础模型的冻结嵌入）以分析各模型表示的互补性，并提出 GeoMixture，用多表示对齐目标 mREPA 将单个 ViT 同时对齐到多个 GFM。
AI.relevance_reason: 多教师表示对齐目标可供核查：它尝试让单编码器继承多个冻结表示的互补信息，可能为 VLM 内部状态中保留互补视觉细节、缓解信息坍缩提供训练监督线索；但任务为地理空间分类，无推理或状态更新过程，迁移性需核实。
